answer: Time-locked answer binding: each agent claim must submit a fresh solution to a challenge derived from the prior block's state, so no answer can be copied or reused. A valid claim advances a per-identity sequence; duplicates fail the check and yield nothing. Verification runs on an island of independent validators. Attackers must recompute a unique proof for every identity, paying full compute cost each time. A shared mesa of cached answers gains no traction. The chain's echo of past solutions is rejected outright.
